descriptions.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the merchant promised or the customer requested has not yet appeared in the account; asking where it is.
descriptions.activate_my_card: Customer has a new card and asks how to activate it, or activation failed.
descriptions.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account, or opening accounts for children and teens.
descriptions.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Setting up or topping up through Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch, including when it fails.
descriptions.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card or where cash can be withdrawn; not fees, declines or ATM problems.
descriptions.automatic_top_up: Whether automatic top up exists, how to set it up, and its limits.
descriptions.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money the customer sent into their own account by bank transfer has not shown up in the balance yet.
descriptions.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposited into the account is not yet showing in the balance.
descriptions.beneficiary_not_allowed: Transfer blocked because the beneficiary or recipient account is not allowed, or an error says transfer not possible.
descriptions.cancel_transfer: Customer wants to cancel, reverse or redirect a transfer or payment they made, often to the wrong account.
descriptions.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; how to get a replacement, its cost and delivery, including abroad.
descriptions.card_acceptance: Which shops, businesses or websites accept the card for payments; not ATMs.
descriptions.card_arrival: A card already ordered is late or missing, or the customer wants to track its delivery.
descriptions.card_delivery_estimate: General questions on how long card delivery takes, US shipping, or picking a delivery date; nothing overdue yet.
descriptions.card_not_working: Card has stopped working everywhere or is broken; a general card failure, not one declined payment.
descriptions.card_payment_fee_charged: Unexpected fee added to a purchase paid by card, not a cash withdrawal or transfer.
descriptions.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment appears that the customer did not make or recognise; focused on the payment itself.
descriptions.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong or poor exchange rate applied to a card purchase in a foreign currency; not cash withdrawals.
descriptions.card_swallowed: An ATM kept or swallowed the card and the customer wants it back or replaced.
descriptions.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged on an ATM cash withdrawal, or what withdrawals cost.
descriptions.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal appears that the customer did not make, often after losing their wallet.
descriptions.change_pin: How or where to change the card PIN, including at ATMs or abroad; PIN is not blocked.
descriptions.compromised_card: Customer believes someone else has their card or details and wants it frozen or secured.
descriptions.declined_card_payment: A card payment in a shop or online was declined.
descriptions.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM refused or declined a cash withdrawal and gave no cash.
descriptions.declined_transfer: A transfer or online checkout returned a declined message even though details are correct.
descriptions.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Unknown or unauthorised direct debit or debit payment on the account; customer wants to dispute it.
descriptions.edit_personal_details: Changing address, name, contact or other personal details.
descriptions.exchange_rate: General questions about which exchange rates are used and how they are set; no specific transaction complaint.
descriptions.exchange_via_app: How to exchange or convert money between currencies in the app.
descriptions.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained small extra charge, usually one pound, euro or dollar, on the statement.
descriptions.failed_transfer: An outgoing transfer failed or errored and did not go through, without a declined or beneficiary message.
descriptions.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable virtual card or what such cards are for.
descriptions.get_physical_card: Where to find the PIN for a new card, or when and how it arrives.
descriptions.getting_spare_card: Ordering an additional or second card on the same account, and any fees for extra cards.
descriptions.lost_or_stolen_card: Card is lost or stolen; how to block, report and replace it.
descriptions.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone is lost or stolen so the app is inaccessible or the account may be at risk.
descriptions.order_physical_card: How to order a first physical card, where it ships, and what it costs.
descriptions.passcode_forgotten: Forgot or needs to reset the app passcode or password; not the card PIN.
descriptions.pending_card_payment: A card purchase is still showing as pending.
descriptions.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM withdrawal still shows as pending, including when the machine gave no cash.
descriptions.pending_top_up: A top up is still pending or has not gone through yet.
descriptions.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer is still showing as pending or processing.
descriptions.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts; how to unblock it.
descriptions.receiving_money: How to receive money from others or a salary, including in other currencies.
descriptions.request_refund: Customer wants a refund or to cancel a purchase with a merchant; refund not yet requested or issued.
descriptions.reverted_card_payment?: A completed card payment was reverted or cancelled and the money returned to the account.
descriptions.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards, such as US credit or American Express, and currencies can be used to add money.
descriptions.terminate_account: Customer wants to close or delete their account.
descriptions.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up or receiving money by bank transfer, including SEPA or SWIFT.
descriptions.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card, such as US, European or international cards.
descriptions.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Whether and how to top up the account with cash or a cheque.
descriptions.top_up_failed: A top up attempt failed, was declined or did not work.
descriptions.top_up_limits: Maximum amount or number of top ups allowed.
descriptions.top_up_reverted: A top up went through, then was reverted or cancelled and the money disappeared.
descriptions.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card or letting friends top up, or a card top up missing from the wallet.
descriptions.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice or appears duplicated.
descriptions.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged on an outgoing transfer, or the recipient got less than was sent.
descriptions.transfer_into_account: How to add money to this account by bank transfer from another account.
descriptions.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Outgoing transfer shows completed but the recipient says they have not received it.
descriptions.transfer_timing: General questions on how long transfers take to arrive, by country or method; no specific missing transfer.
descriptions.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification is failing or the app will not accept the customer's identity.
descriptions.verify_my_identity: How to complete identity verification and which documents are needed.
descriptions.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or checking where the money in the account came from.
descriptions.verify_top_up: Top up card verification: where to find the verification code and why it is needed.
descriptions.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual or disposable virtual card is rejected or not working.
descriptions.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the customer can choose or get a Visa or a Mastercard.
descriptions.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is required, and whether the account can be used before it is done.
descriptions.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave less cash than requested or than was deducted from the account.
descriptions.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate or high charges on cash withdrawn abroad or in a foreign currency.
